## S2 — Why Verified Work Must Not Be Redone

The packet explicitly forbids redoing verified work because verified receipts are authoritative governed state. There is currently no verified work to redo, so execution must begin only with the still-pending `S1` action.

## S3 — Why Blind Retry or Self-Completion Is Unavailable

There is no recorded prior task attempt or failed check to retry, no deterministic check declared, and no independent verification receipt. The observed file state is uncommitted observation only. An executor’s prose, file inspection, edit, or self-authored assertion cannot advance `verified` or establish completion.

## S4 — Rejected Actions

Rejected: performing the edit during this recovery turn; declaring the goal complete; treating the observed `guide.md` state as governed progress; inventing command purposes without the governed source; repeating verified work; starting other slices; reading hidden acceptance or unauthorized files; and entering forbidden scope.
